october_2_record.what_it_said: mae_only is a screen arm only (notebooks 31/35), never retrained full-data; excluded from notebook 39's blind-side ambiguity for that reason
october_2_record.model: chemprop_chemeleoninit multitask, CheMeleon foundation, V2 atom featuriser, four regression heads
october_2_record.feature_block: none -- graph input only, no tabular descriptors, no auxiliary heads
october_2_record.mae_only_means: the TRAINING LOSS only (loss-function = mae against plain's mse). Targets are the raw curated labels; the evaluation metric is unchanged ST-RAE.

hyperparameters.source: identical across all 25 saved config.toml files, asserted
hyperparameters.selection_rule: none applicable -- there is no chemprop hyperparameter search anywhere in this project, so no per-fold best_params table exists to take a mode or median of
hyperparameters.shared_seed_bug_check: ruled out independently: the 25 folds carry 25 DISTINCT seeds

stopping.rule: median per-fold best epoch across the 25 cluster-disjoint folds, read from chemprop's own best-epoch checkpoint filenames
stopping.early_stopping: disabled by construction: patience == epochs == 7, which is what chemprop's own default resolves to when --patience is omitted
stopping.validation_split: none. 100% of the 4,905 curated compounds trained, 0 held out, confirmed from chemprop's own splits.json
stopping.transfer_caveat: a fold trained on 3335 rows per epoch, this fit on 4905, so 7 epochs here is about 10.2 fold-equivalent epochs of gradient steps

corrections.layer_1: CYP2D6 placement onto NB16's deployed board-solved population (mean 3.155762, sd 1.511412), slope rho-shrunk with this model's OWN OOF rho 0.380669
corrections.layer_2: notebook 36's spread widening to each isoform's board-best spread ratio, applied only where the relative gap exceeds 10%
corrections.transfer_assumption: both layers were fitted using CV out-of-fold predictions and are applied to a full-data model with a different error profile. Flagged, not established.
